payload.title: Investigating interhemispheric precipitation changes over the past millennium
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook explores interhemispheric precipitation changes over the past millennium by comparing paleoclimate model outputs with proxy observations. It employs Empirical Orthogonal Function (EOF) analysis to identify large-scale spatio-temporal patterns. The notebook utilizes data from the CESM Last Millennium Ensemble and proxy datasets from the LinkedEarth database. The analysis includes PCA on both model and proxy data, followed by a model-data comparison to visualize the results.
goals: Compare paleoclimate model output with proxy observations.
Identify large-scale spatio-temporal patterns using EOF analysis.
Perform PCA on gridded and point datasets for model-data comparison.
